chapters.title: Chapter 117: The 12 Major Merchant Families
paragraphs: The Athea Kingdom has three kinds of families: the Merchant, Noble, and Legacy Families.
Merchant Families are the backbone of trade and commerce. They control the flow of goods, services, and wealth within the kingdom.
These families operate vast networks of caravans, ships, and marketplaces, ensuring that the cities remain well-supplied.

Merchant Families often influence local economies and form alliances with nobles and commoners to expand their wealth. While they don’t hold political power, their riches give them considerable sway in kingdom affairs.
Noble Families are the rulers of the various cities in the kingdom. Each Noble Family governs a specific city and surrounding lands, overseeing laws, taxes, and military forces.
They are tasked with maintaining order, protecting their territories, and ensuring the prosperity of their regions.
These families are granted titles such as Lords and Ladies, and their influence shapes the culture and politics of the Athea Kingdom.
Legacy Families stand above all others and are the kings of the kingdom. They are the royal bloodlines that rule the four kingdoms on the continent.
Legacy Families are seen as divine or chosen by higher powers, entrusted with the ultimate authority over the kingdom’s fate.
They can unify the cities, declare wars, or establish peace. The Legacy Families ensure stability across the kingdoms while managing relationships between the Noble and Merchant Families.
Together, these three types of families create a delicate balance in the Athea Kingdom, each playing a critical role in its governance, prosperity, and survival.
However, while these three types of families may appear harmonious on the surface, they all covet each other’s roles.
The lower Merchant Families aspire to rise to the level of the Major ones, while the Major Families dream of becoming Nobles.
Similarly, the Noble Families harbor ambitions of becoming Legacy Families and ruling the entire kingdom.
This ambition led to Dave Ashland’s downfall, resulting in his family being razed to the ground overnight. A tragic end, but no one sympathized with them.
They had brought it upon themselves by daring to challenge a higher power through nefarious means.
Now that the Ashland Noble Family is no more, the twelve Major Merchant Families from the twelve cities of the Athea Kingdom are vying for the chance to ascend and claim the mantle of nobility.
These Major Merchant Families have earned their recognition through their significant contributions to the kingdom.
The Oren Family is known for their sales of weapons. They supply the army as well as various merchant families and businesses that deal in weapons.
It is said that this family has connections with the Dwarven Empire, making them one of the few to hold such prestige.

The Axel Family is renowned for their excellence in alchemy. They are among the major suppliers of pills and alchemy-related materials in the kingdom, and like the Oren Family, they also have connections with the Elven Empire.
The Grayson Family is widely known for their jade mining businesses. They contribute significantly to the jade market in the human kingdoms and beyond.
The Basil Family are also miners; their field is gold and spirit stones. They are one of the most powerful merchant families out there.
The Martial Family, on the other hand, is what one might call the perfect fit for the position of nobility. Their family comes from a unique bloodline specializing in healing.
The Martial Family are the healers; even the Kings held dear in all four major kingdoms. Their healing powers are of immense commercial value to them.
So, while one may argue they shouldn’t be classified as a merchant family, everyone knows they are indeed very powerful and highly valued.

The Otto Family is focused on the sales of herbs. They sometimes clash with the Axel Family, known for alchemy. However, while one might say the pill and herb markets are the same, they are also distinct.

So, while they may seem to be operating in the same sphere, there would be no pills without herbs. Because of this, over time, the Axel Family stepped back and allowed the Otto Family to dominate the herb market.
The Falk Family dominates the sea trade. They are widely known for building ships and transporting goods between kingdoms and empires.
While reaching the ancient battlefield of Parting allows one to cross into other empires, traveling by sea is also a viable option.
However, to do so, one must possess either a flying treasure with sufficient defense or a ship equipped with enough firepower. The Falk Family thrives in this sector.
The Vexen Family specializes in the textile and silk trade. They are the best merchant family to connect with, as they maintain extensive ties with both the Elven and Dwarven Empires.
The Calder Family are expert tamers. They supply exotic spirit beasts to the kingdoms and are considered some of the finest beast tamers in the human empire.
Due to their unique skill set, they are regarded as one of the most important merchant families.
The Draycott Family deals in wine and spirit medicine, supplying their goods to kingdoms and beyond.

It is said that all wines crafted by the Draycott Family are heavenly, often selling for thousands of spirit stones. In fact, they own some of the finest restaurants and wine parlors in the kingdoms, further emphasizing their importance.
The Valen Family serves as the kingdom’s information network. They are the go-to source for purchasing intelligence on anything within the kingdom and beyond.
They are one of the few merchant families no one dares to cross. In fact, they possess secrets so potent that, if revealed, they could disrupt the economy overnight.
Though they don’t deal in tangible products, their information is invaluable for those seeking to navigate the world with minimal obstacles.
But while these 11 are important, the Zephyr family is perhaps the overlord of all merchant families.

They are overly important because of the trade they specialize in. They are known for selling rare artifacts, and they own most auction houses, the most popular and important being the Silver Leaf Auction House.
They run many businesses that deal in rare items like skills, techniques, rare artifacts, and even cultivation secrets that can’t be found anywhere else.
They have some of the best exploration teams that enter ancient tombs, realms, ruins, and other domains to unearth lost artifacts from the passage of time.
In fact, their importance is so great that the kingdom listens to them more than anyone. However, they are merchants; thus, they are present to determine who will become the next noble in the city.
Now, inside one of the big meeting rooms in Caprath City, the 12 patriarchs of these major merchant families meet to decide who inherits the noble title.

They all want that title to spread their influence far and wide. They wouldn’t be wasting their energy if becoming a noble wasn’t something to fight for. They want the fame, the power, and the secrets that come with being a noble.
Since it can’t be done through war, they can only meet and think of a way to move forward. After all, they all want to know what it feels like to be a noble.

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Choosing The Way Forward
paragraphs: "I think we all know why we are here, so instead of beating around the bush, we can get straight in," the Patriarch of the Oren Merchant Family, Max, said, addressing the individuals gathered around the table.
"Come on, Max, we all know we are here for the same thing, but instead of diving right in, why don’t we discuss matters that are equally of importance first?" Daven of the Axel Family chimed in.
"We all know what happened to the Ashlands and the Alderfords. Aren’t we going to discuss that first?" he stated.

"Indeed, we have to talk about that first. I believe something is going on, and from what I have seen and heard, whoever did this is perhaps very dangerous," Norlon, the Patriarch of the Otto Merchant Family, said.
"Then why don’t you tell all of us what you think? I believe your input will be valuable, don’t you think?" Max said, his tone slightly laced with anger and disdain.
Clearly, it appears the Axel and Otto families are still not on friendly terms. The Pill and Herb Market is still a point of contention between them.

"As it stands, I only know that whoever has done this to the two families may be a threat to all of us. It will be best if we all focus on understanding that before going deep into whatever we came here to do,"
Norton said before turning to Cyran, the Patriarch of the Valen Merchant Family, known for information gathering and espionage.
Cyran looked at everyone’s faces before sighing.
Truth be told, he already has information on both families, the Ashlands and the Alderfords. However, his family treated that information as a high-paying commodity.
They dealt in information, so sharing something that grand for free didn’t sit right with him. However, under these circumstances, he could compromise and say something small.

"I do have information on the two. However, you should know I don’t plan on dropping names. That said, I will tell you this: the two families didn’t die at the same hand. Though they were not on good terms, they both died from completely different causes.
They both fell to underworld organizations I can’t name. If you want names, you’ll have to buy them."
Everyone looked at each other’s faces before sighing. Truth be told, they had all expected as much. They knew it must have something to do with the underworld for a noble family to fall.
However, they never anticipated that two families would fall at the same time and at the hands of two different underworld organizations.
Although Cyran hadn’t named any names, they all knew his words were 100% true. They just hated the fact that he knew something but wouldn’t share it without compensation.
"I think we all know why this happened. Now, can we focus on yet another factor before diving into the way forward?" Patriarch Max said.

"What else is there to talk about? We know who the culprits are. Though some people are too petty to name names, we now understand this is the work of the underworld. From where I stand, we move forward with deciding who gets to become the noble," Patriarch Ender of the Basil Gold Mining family said.
"I think so too. Max, what else is there to discuss?" Patriarch Norton asked.

"I think, because of the recent incidents, you’ve all forgotten something else. Have you forgotten about the recent perfect pills that have appeared in the Athea Kingdom? I believe it’s something we should address, don’t you all think?"
The faces of the twelve gathered seemed to shift upon hearing the mention of the perfect pill.
The sudden appearance of the Perfect Pills threatens the current status quo. This is why they all want to get to the bottom of things.

"I believe Patriarch Lorian is the best person to answer this. It was your auction house that got hold of these pills. I believe you have something to tell us," Patriarch Daven of the Axel family said.
Right now, he runs the risk of losing more if these Perfect Pills start circulating. His family, being alchemists specializing in making pills, faces significant consequences.
If, suddenly, pills without a strand of impurity start appearing, things will go badly for them.
He needed to know what was going on, and since Kent’s pills first appeared in the Silver Leaf Auction House, which belongs to the Zephyr Family, Lorian, the patriarch, was the best fit to answer.
"Like I said before and the last hundred times, the worker who got hold of these pills said the alchemist behind them doesn’t want to be known by anyone just yet.

Also, she said the alchemist warned that if we start poking around, he will stop making the pills. Now, I don’t know about you bastards, but my family cannot let such a rare chance like this go to waste.

So, before you start pressuring me, know that I don’t even know the identity of this alchemist. Also, it would be best to assume he or she will soon make an appearance, so be prepared to make contact. That is all I can say."
In truth, even Lorian had been pressuring Manager Alina to reach out to Kent, who had chosen to remain anonymous for now.
The recent developments prompted Kent to build his strength first before taking any bold steps that could send him face-to-face with danger.
"I guess it’s only natural. From where I stand, we can’t force someone who doesn’t want to be known," Max said, turning to look at everyone.
"Now that we have addressed these two things, I will go straight to the point and voice my proposed plan for which family gets to become noble.

Since we all deal in different fields, it’s only natural for us to not have a common ground to decide. So, I propose we make this huge decision five months from now during the King’s Martial Competitions.
We all have sects we support. While it might be good to go to war, we can refrain from that and use the competition to decide.
Whoever’s sect wins will get to become the next noble of this kingdom," Max said, making everyone enter brief contemplation.

"I think supporting an entire sect is good. This will make things much easier. My Zephyr Family and the Divine Palace Sect will accept this," Lorian, one of the major contributors to the Divine Palace Sect, agreed to the offer.
"I think this is a nice way forward too. My Axel Family and the Everlasting Alchemy Sect will also participate in this enterprise," Daven said, looking rather smug.

Just as there are twelve major merchant families, there are also twelve major sects that vie for fame every three years in what they call the King’s Sect Competition, which will take place five months from now.

If they want to pick the next best noble family without much bloodshed, it would be best to use such a method. And because they will present this to the king, there won’t be any disagreement later on.
The other families accepted the offer to use the sect competition to determine the next noble family. After a few more discussions, they left.

Since they all came to the same conclusion, all that remains is for them to pump their resources into the sects they support and hope that in five months, these sects will become their swords and wands to determine their future.

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Lady Agnis/Olive
paragraphs: Somewhere along the coastlines of Eldor, the capital city of the Eldorath Kingdom, one of the four kingdoms in the human continent, a dark crow with a wingspan of two meters sped toward the mountaintop city visible in the far distance.
Eldor is one of the most attractive and renowned cities in the Eldorath Kingdom and the human continent at large.
The city, perched atop a massive mountain, has a serene charm that draws people seeking a few days of peace.

Indeed, the city is a haven for peaceful living. The King of Eldorath ensured this, making Eldor not only the safest of all the capital cities on the human continent but also the most welcoming for all kinds of life.
The crow continued its flight toward the city but, two miles away, landed gracefully on the ground and transformed into a striking beauty with dark hair and a refined figure.
She was adorned in dark silk clothing and wore eyeglasses that gave her the appearance of a scholar.
The lady walked toward the city with steady steps, careful not to let even a speck of dust soil her perfect and slender legs.
"Lady Agnis, a pleasure to see you again."
As she approached the majestic gates leading to the city, the guards, who immediately recognized her, greeted her with deep respect.
This could mean only one thing: the woman named Agnis was a person of influence in the city.
"It’s nice to see you guys too. Tell me, what has happened while I was gone? Any juicy gossip?" she asked with a cute smile that instantly captivated the guards.
In fact, all around who saw the lady pass were captivated by her charm. They all wanted to get close to her and kiss her feet.

"Not that much, but we recently learned one of the noble families was wiped out overnight. Also, a merchant family experienced a similar fate. That is all," the guard said, making Lady Agnis nod and continue her journey.
"You four should come around some time to receive a potion I recently prepared. You wouldn’t want to disappoint your young ladies in bed, right?" Lady Agnis said while moving again.

The four guards smiled upon hearing her words. They all knew her as one of the few healers in Eldor City. Those who knew her well were aware that she specialized in making potions to enhance and spice up one’s sex life.
The lady moved through the busy streets for a while before arriving at a quiet, secluded house somewhere at the corner of the city.
"Home sweet home," she muttered before entering the house.
She chose to relax for a bit before getting back to her life. However, her plans were cut short when a certain shadow moved, and a man appeared.
"You are back, Agnis," the man said.
Agnis, who was perhaps expecting the man, nodded and stood up. She then tapped into her soul ring and retrieved a key.
"I have completed the mission, leader. I managed to retrieve the key from the humans and escaped with my subordinates."
The man received the key and appraised it for a few seconds before putting it away.
"You have done well, Agnis. The Hand will reward you," the man said before taking out a small box from his space ring.
"Inside contains a Tier 8 Core of a Spirit Beast and a Tier 8 Soul Shard. Take this as your reward—you have earned it."
Lady Agnis received her reward with a proud smile.
"Use the next few months to relax. The teams on the Elven Continent are closing in on the next key. Soon, we will have two of the seven. You have really done well, Agnis.
However, your work is not done," the man stated, making Agnis look back at him.
"What do you require of me, leader? I will do anything for the Hand," she replied.

The man smiled. "The Oracle has recently discovered a Variable that, in some way, can block our plans. For now, the Oracle is still in the process of uncovering the identity of this Variable, but the moment it is uncovered, you will have to go out there again.
Use this time to consolidate your strength and wait for further orders," the leader said before moving back into the shadows.
In the next second, the shadow was gone from the room.

Lady Agnis, who everyone in the Alderford family would recognize as Lady Olive, sighed and sat back down. She had been tasked with locating the first key, which, luckily for her, was with someone she had shared a steamy night with.
In fact, when she found out John had the key, she reached out to the Hand and made a plea to be the one to extract it.
Although she knew her status hadn’t reached the level required to pursue one of the Pandorax keys, she convinced them she could do it.
She was thankful that, through her charm and nature as a Soulmancer, she was able to take over John’s body and soul.
This allowed her to get what she wanted. Thankfully, the Hand didn’t doubt her and even sent her more than enough forces to take down the Alderfords.
"I will have to kill the bitch later. If she didn’t have that annoying talent, I would have long finished this quest," she muttered, the image of Cynthia Alderford appearing in her mind.
What nobody besides Lady Olive knew was that Cynthia possessed a unique class—even she didn’t fully understand it.
Olive was a Soulmancer, someone who tapped into souls and manipulated them. Their job was essentially to turn people into puppets on a soul level.
But soulmancers had a counter, and these counters were known as Aetherwardens. Their role was to act as guardians of spiritual balance and disruptors of soul manipulation.
Cynthia is an Aetherwarden.
This prevented her from getting into John’s soul at first. However, when John started neglecting Cynthia, she found a way into his soul and managed to turn him to her side.

"I need to kill her. For now, she doesn’t know what she is. I need to kill her before she awakens her true nature." Lady Olive lay on her bed, formulating ways to kill the only counter that could stand against her.
Soulmancers are powerful, but an Aetherwarden can render their existence meaningless.
She knew this, and for that reason, she would stop at nothing to achieve her goals. She had already tried using John to end her, but thankfully, the Sword Saintess saved her.
This was one of the reasons she attacked the Alderfords and stole everything they had. Since Cynthia was now vulnerable and had nothing, the chances of reaching her were very high.
In fact, she expect Cynthia to be drowning in debt by now, Lady Olive believed she would be able to get what she wanted much more easily.
Unfortunately for Lady Olive, things were about to change, and this change would affect not only her but all Soulmancers.

[You have absorbed enough yin essence to level up. Current Level: Root Master Lvl 9]
[You have reached the bottleneck... Attempting to break through to the Root Grandmaster stage.]
[Congratulations, you have broken through to the Root Grandmaster Stage. Current Level: Lvl 1.]
[Requirement Met. The Primordial Chaos Dragon Tower is awakening.]
[Time until completion: 15 Minutes]
Everything happened so quickly that before Kent knew it, he had leveled up twice and broken through to the Grandmaster stage. However, the most incredible change was the awakening message.
He had been anticipating this moment for a while now. Finally, it was happening. Finally, his cheat system was awakening. This meant his days of glory were about to begin.

’I wonder what buff I will be receiving,’ Kent thought as he waited for the 15 long minutes to pass. Impatience gnawed at him ten minutes later, but he held himself back and waited for the remaining five minutes.
The moment the 15 minutes struck, Kent’s smile bloomed.
[Congratulations. You have awakened the Primordial Chaos Dragon Tower.]
[The Tower has fully been integrated into your soul. All awakened Towers are now unlocked.]

[The Tower has a message for her master: I will accompany the Master for all eternity, so the Master should give me a name. Note: The Master cannot give me the name "Tower." I prefer a different name.]
Kent scratched his head, staring at the message floating before him. He knew it was normal to name a system, but he never expected one to be this shameless.
Still, the perfect name immediately popped into his mind.
"I will call you Gaia. From today onward, your name is Gaia," Kent said with a smile.
[Name Registered. The Master has received two rewards from Gaia. The Master can open it after everything is done. Now, why don’t we start.]
Kent immediately felt his consciousness being pulled away. In the blink of an eye, he stood in a dark void. He was out of his body and was now somewhere in the void, or so it seems.
There was no light, no sound—just an endless expanse of eerie darkness. Suddenly, a small light appeared in the far distance, rapidly approaching him.
Moments later, a golden tower about the size of an adult’s fist floated before Kent.
"Gaia, is that you?" Kent asked, staring at the golden tower.
[Yes, Master.]
"I see. You’re rather cute compared to when I first saw you in the God Realm. Now, can you tell me why we’re here or what this place is?" Kent asked.
[This is your Soul Sea, Master,] Gaia responded.
"Soul Sea? You’d better explain, Gaia. I don’t know anything about Soul Seas or whatever they are," Kent said with a smile.

[The Soul Sea is a part of your soul, Master. It is where your consciousness and spiritual power reside. Every cultivator has one, but most never learn how to access it until they reach the Root Ascension stage]
"So, this is like my personal space?" Kent asked, tilting his head.
[Exactly, Master. It’s where I, as your system, can communicate with you directly. It’s also where your soul energy gathers and grows.]
"I see," Kent looked around and then asked, "Why is it dark? I presume if this is where my soul energy gathers, shouldn’t it look more lively and world-like?"

[That is indeed true. Naturally, I was supposed to do that before bringing you here, but for future benefits and for the sake of knowledge, I brought you here to witness the awakening of your Soul Sea and the Tower.
Are you ready?] Gaia said in a rather cute and excited voice.
"Let’s do it." Kent also sounded happy. The reason for that, however, is unknown for now.
[Then it’s time for you to meet the real me, Master.]
Immediately after, Gaia said that a blinding white light appeared in the space, immediately dispelling the darkness.
"Primordial Chaos World Creation begins!" Gaia shouted. Suddenly, chaotic energy filled the space, shaking the ground Kent was standing on.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!
Loud explosions rocked the place, making Kent look around him in alarm. Suddenly, like a volcano, a powerful gush of energy burst into the space, filling it with potent energy.
"World Merge, World Creation Begin!"
The energy started spreading miles around the space. Suddenly, a large plain of grass appeared, followed by thirteen moons and a single sun gracing the horizon.

The mountains, rivers, plants, valleys, clouds, and everything that makes a world look vibrant began to materialize. Suddenly, the space began twisting. Then, like the descent of a celestial object, a tall golden tower fell from the sky and landed in the open space.
"Tower Merging initiated. Merging in 4...3...2...1. Tower merging successful."
A powerful energy wave swept across the area, forcing Kent to close his eyes. When he reopened them, a world that looked just like the outside world appeared before his vision.
It looks very vibrant and soothing.
"Tower Merging successful. Soul Sea awakening."
Kent, who anticipated everything, overlooked the far distance where a very large sea began raging.
Suddenly, a dragon’s roar erupted beneath the sea, sending shockwaves everywhere.
On the outside, Kent, seated on the bed, smiled as if a pair of dark gold dragon horns appeared on his forehead. Then, like transforming, his bones began shifting and restructuring.
If someone had been watching, they would have been horrified at the sight of his bones reshaping themselves.

A few minutes later, the bones fully reformed, and dragon scales appeared on his skin. They were also dark gold, each exuding a powerful energy that seemed to knock Cynthia, waking up unconscious again.
Fortunately, no one else was in the mansion, or they would have experienced a similar fate. The energy is very chaotic, to say the least.
An hour later, both the horns and scales receded, revealing a physique that only those who had tempered their bodies for years could achieve.
His bone structure had changed, and the new Kent looked strikingly handsome, his charm elevated to a new height.
Another hour passed before Kent opened his eyes. Immediately, the Tower reappeared before him.
[Everything is set now; it’s time for the Master to see what I have to offer and why his destiny is about to take a new turn.]
The Tower glowed and entered Kent’s forehead. In the next second, dozens of messages appeared before his vision, making the purple-haired dragon smile warmly.
The tower appeared again to let its master focus on the messages.

paragraphs: "Gaia, let’s take them one by one. I don’t want to miss anything," Kent said. Gaia obeyed and rearranged the messages so that Kent wouldn’t be overwhelmed.
He first wants to explore the messages before entering the tower to check it out actively.
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Harem Tower]
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Sword Tower]
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Alchemy Tower]
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Soul Tower]
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Guardian Tower]
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Servant Tower]
[Congratulation, you have awakened the Legion Tower]
==Welcome to the Tower==
-- You now have access to the following features.
<Tower shop>
-- You can now spend your Tower Points in the Tower shop to buy treasures of your liking that are available in the Tower shop. Dont ask how they got there.
<Tower Storage>
-- The master can now enter and leave the tower storage as he pleases. The tower storage can also be accessed using the consciousness.
-- No one can detect all items stored in the tower storage. Not even a god.
<Tower Prison>
-- The master can now imprison those who offend him in the tower Prison. Note that all those imprisoned will be stripped of their cultivation (temporarily, if you want).
<Tower City>
-- The master can build cities by spending tower points on anything he wants. The master must know that the more people he added to the tower, the more space he would need to accommodate them.
-- So with 10 million Tower Points as a starting fee, the master can build a functioning City.
-- The master is advised not to be stingy and spend on his city.
[Note: The master must know that to run a tower, it requires loads of Tower points]
Kent just continued to read with a huge smile on his face. Right now, he feels like he can do anything. The tower is now open to him, and he can do whatever he pleases.
He can now buy things using his million tower points. He would do that right after finishing the rest of the messages.
==== Harem Tower =====
-- This tower ensures the Master does more than just sleep with any woman. With this tower, both the master and those he recognizes as his women will grow through sex.
Abilities Unlocked.
<Absorb>
-- The master absorbs the yin qi of any woman he has sex with.
<Telepathy>
-- The master can telepathically communicate with all the ladies in his harem.
<Teleport>
-- The master can teleport to the location of all ladies added to the harem
<Take>
-- The Master can take skills and techniques from all ladies added to the harem
<Bestow>
-- The master can bestow skills and techniques to all ladies added to the Harem
<Bestow and Invoke True Names>
-- When conditions are met, the master bestows a suitable true name to his harem ladies.
-- Each Harem member’s [True Name Benefits] will be known when a true name is invoked.
[Unlocked Features]
<Yin Pool>
-- Your harem members can now access the yin pool, which they can cultivate to enhance their yin qi and beauty.
<Pleasure Bed>
-- You now have access to the bed of pleasure where you and your women experience 40% enhanced sweetness during sexy times.
-- The bed cleans itself whenever it gets dirty
<Love Garden>
-- The master and harem members can now access the love garden, where they can spend time in each other’s embrace.
[Benefits]
-- The master receives between +100 and +100,000 stat points when a new member is added to the harem.
-- The master receives 10% of the spiritual qi from each harem member when they cultivate.
-- Depending on how solid their foundations are, the master receives between +100 and +20,000 Stat points anytime a harem member levels up.
-- The master receives between +100 and +100,000 Soul essence anytime a harem member levels up.
-- In dangerous situations, the master will receive 60% of the total strength of all harem members combined for 20 minutes.
[Harem Members]
<Vexthra Dy Sitri (Locked)>
<Unity Hanks>
<Lilian Alderford>
Note: Due to some requirements not being met, the harem member named Vexthra cannot contribute to the harem benefits.
"Hmm, Gaia, can you tell me the requirements I have to meet to unlock the ban on Vexthra?" Kent asked. It seems dealing with a goddess is going to be a little painful.
[The master must first become a Spirit Core Formation stage expert before these requirements will be revealed to the master]
"I see," Kent muttered. "I guess it makes sense. After all, her yin qi can kill me before I try absorbing it."
Ventura has already informed Kent that he must first reach the spirit Core formation stage before her yin qi starts having an effect on him.
For now, he doesn’t know to what extent these changes will be, but he is looking forward to it.
In fact, he can’t wait to reach that level and see how much changes the yin essence of a goddess will have on him.
==== Sword Tower ====
-- Your sword is your life, your path, and your soul. To walk the path, one must tread the unknown and seek the unknown.
[Class: Swordsman (Pseudo-Master)]
[Trait: Sword Aura (Enhanced) | Sword Intent (Enhanced) | Sword Body (Copper)]
[Aspects: Draconic Strength | Chaos Energy Infusion | Draconic Skin]
[Legacy: Chaos Blade (Locked)]
[Sword Play Progress 7,020/10,002]
[Unlocked Features]
<Eternal Sword Arena>
-- The master can now access the eternal sword arena where he can practice with perfect dummies.
-- Death is not permanent.
<Enlightenemnt Stone>
-- The master can now practice the sword’s mind technique using the enlightenment stone.
-- The Master gains 60% enhanced clarity when using the enlightenment stone to understand the sword.
<Sword Dream>
-- The master can now access the sword dream state and challenge the real illusions of famous swordsmen to a sword fight.
-- If the master wins, his traits will be boosted in real life.
<Perfect Sword View>
-- The master can now access the perfect Sword view and watch the perfect way to use a sword technique before learning it.
-- The view will display the best and countless ways a swordsman can use a sword technique.
--If your imagination is wide, you can envision millions of ways to execute sword moves inside the perfect sword view.
[Benefits]
-- When practicing in the sword Tower, all stats will temporarily Gain +200 Points.
-- All forms of sword techniques will become clear when practicing in the sword tower.
-- Whenever you level up inside the sword tower, your starts will receive a +10 boost.
"Gaia, tell me this is a joke," Kent asked.
[This is not a prank, Master. This is the might of the Towers. For now, the Master can take this as the initial awakening benefits of the Towers. As the Master grows, so will the Towers.

The Master must know I am a celestial-grade soul item, a one-of-a-kind soul item. I surpass your current imagination. So, instead of overthinking, you can embrace the change and move forward while having fun.]
"I see. Then, if this is just the initial stage, can you satiate my curiosity by telling me the highest I can go with the Towers?" Kent’s curiosity was getting the best of him.
Having read about all these amazing features, he wanted to know just how much he would be unlocking in the future.
[The Master can take a seed and align it with the current level of the Tower, then imagine it growing and blossoming into a towering tree with countless ripe fruits.
After that, imagine millions of those trees spread across a million acres of land. This is about to cover the intermediate nature of the Tower.]
"Damn~"

chapters.title: Chapter 126: The Tower Awakening (3)
paragraphs: Kent sat with his mouth wide open, his imagination completely shattered. He would now have to figure out what to imagine next.
If the current Tower was but an infant, how terrifying would it become as a teenager or an adult? Just the thought made him giddy.
"Tell me something—would the Tower be visible for anyone to see?" Kent asked.
[No, Master. The Tower is not something anyone but you can see. However, I can create a replica and place it in each Tower space if you wish.
For now, only you have the means to see me. Nobody, including Celestial Gods, can see me. Also, I’ll just answer since you’re already thinking about it.
Though I mentioned different Towers, they’re more like worlds within me. The golden Tower you saw contains all these worlds.
So, if you enter the Harem Tower, you will see all its features inside a unique world that will grow as I grow.
Also, though I didn’t list it, the spiritual qi density inside the Tower is much denser than in this world. Also, a day inside the tower is an hour outside]
"I see. That makes sense. Honestly, I thought there would be Towers scattered everywhere. That would’ve been a low blow. For now, let’s keep things the way they are," Kent sighed.
[As it should be, Master.]
===Alchemy Tower===
-- The path of alchemy is something many take for granted. They think alchemy is just about making pills. While they may be true in a way, Alchemy in itself is a way of life.
-- It’s a life one must walk with grace and respect. All in all, alchemists are the most respected because they are dangerous.
[Features Unlocked]
<Alchemy Garden>
-- You can now plant all kinds of herbs in the Alchemy Garden.
-- Herbs planted grow at a rate of 10 days per minute. This means every 10 days inside the garden is a minute outside.
-- This rate can be increased if powerful power sources are added to the garden
<Pill Room>
-- You can now access the tower pill room to concoct Pills.
-- all alchemy knowledge will become 40% more pronounced when inside the pill room.
-- All Pills concocted inside the pill room will have a 30% boost in quality.
<Pill World>
-- You can now access the pill world, where every time you are inside it, you will be transported to a dreamlike realm where you will witness the world of alchemy in many worlds.
-- Everything you see was something that happened before.
Kent nodded, knowing that, at this point, he could only read and be happy. Imagining it further felt like a waste of time, and he knew it.
[The Master should know that inside the Alchemy Tower, all his senses will be sharpened by a staggering 140% to gain clarity in the path of pill-making much faster.]
"I see. That is great, Gaia. I guess this is my luck," Kent smiled before turning to the next items.
===Soul Tower===

-- The soul is a delicate thing. It’s what makes everyone and what could break anyone. The soul needs nourishment, and it can be nourished. With a tower dedicated to nourishing and harnessing its true name, the soul can become a deadly weapon.
-- Inside the soul tower, your absorption speed is boosted by 60%.
-- Your comprehension speed also increases by 80%
[Unique Abilities]
<Soul Absorb>
-- You can absorb the soul essence from things you kill.
-- You can also absorb their memories temporarily.
<Soul Wall>
-- A wall has been raised around your soul that prevents all forms of soul attacks from damaging your soul.
<Soul Chain>
-- When in trouble, the master can tap into the soul of all added to his tower to boost your soul strength.
-- Those linked to the tower won’t feel discomfort using this soul chain.
[Features Unlocked]
<Soul Pagoda>
-- The master can now climb the soul pagoda, where every level of the pagoda strengthens the soul.
-- At each level, the master will be subjected to a trial that, when passed, will strengthen the soul.
-- Every level has rewards that will be revealed after passing.
"This is more than I can ask for. At this rate, I will become a powerhouse within weeks if I spend more time inside the tower."

[I know, right? Also, when traveling to distant places, you can just stay in the tower and pay me handsomely with tower points, and I will take you there. You don’t have to walk if you don’t want to.]
"I see. We will talk about your hunger for money later." Kent smiled, imagining all the amazing things he could do with the tower.
[The master is right. We will have to talk about ways for you to earn loads of tower points.]
’I can’t believe the shameless, perverted tower is a lady,’ Klaus thought inwardly.
[You do know I can hear you, right? Also, I have different personalities, so yes, I can be a pervert sometimes, but it’s what my master wants. Are you not?]
"That is indeed true. Keep doing an amazing job, Gaia," Kent said with a smile, then moved on to the next tower.
===Guardian Tower===
-- A guardian must protect. A guardian must fight for his wards. The guardian tower is there so a guardian can protect his wards.
-- Inside the guardian tower, the guardian can create ways to protect their wards.
-- You also receive 10% spiritual qi of all those you add to the guardian tower.
-- You receive +100 soul essence from all those added to the guardian tower whenever they level up.
[Current Member]
<Li Hua>
"Gaia, why are there no features for this one?" Kent asked. The other towers had features he could access, yet this one didn’t seem to have any.
[That is because this tower is only accessible to the tower master. Inside are ways for you to protect your wards.
I won’t spoil anything, so hurry up and enter to see for yourself. Also, the Guardian Tower is where you should spend more money. Trust me, you’ll want to spend money on it.]
"No need to be vague, tower. Tell me something at least," Kent pressed.
[Very well. The Guardian Tower isn’t just for show or for a single person. No, the Guardian Tower exists to protect people. These people can be a single individual, a group, or even an entire race.
But while that sounds amazing, becoming the guardian of an entire race also comes with its own challenges. Do you have the means to protect them all?
The answer is yes. The Guardian Tower functions like a store that sells methods for safeguarding your wards. You can use tower points to unlock tools and resources to ensure their protection.
To fuel your imagination, why don’t you picture a scene where, in your absence, thousands of Steel Knights or Steel Golems are defending your wards?
Now, take it up a notch and imagine a massive dragon appearing to shield your wards when they’re in danger while you’re away.
Can you picture it now, Master?]
"Damn, you’re a good saleswoman," Kent said with a smug smile. As Gaia described, he pictured such scenes, and what he imagined filled him with excitement.
After all, the more he added to the Guardian Tower, the stronger he became.

chapters.title: Chapter 127: The Tower Awakening (4)
paragraphs: ===Servant Tower===
-- The term servants may sound bad to many, but in the master’s case, the term servant is a way for those who want to follow the master to grow with him.
-- The servant tower is where the master can add those he deems worthy to become his servants. They are not slaves because they choose to join willingly.
-- The master cannot betray them. They also cannot betray the master.
-- The master receives 10% of the spiritual qi from all those added to the tower when they cultivate.
-- The master receives +100 soul essence from all those added to the tower when they level up.
-- The master can bestow abilities, skills, techniques, and True Names he deems fit to all those linked to the servant tower.
-- When the trust level of servants reaches 80%, they will unlock a unique talent ability called [Servants Destiny].
<Servant’s Destiny>
-- All stats will receive a 120% Boost.
-- Comprehension speed will increase by 120%
-- The chances of awakening a True Name are very high if they don’t have one already.
[Feature Unlocked]
<Servant space>
-- A unique space where all servants can meet and socialize away from the Tower City or other spaces the master grants them access to.
-- The time inside this space is the same as in the outside world.
"Not too bad, I guess. But I don’t plan on getting any more servants," Kent said.
[That won’t be wise, Master. With all the amazing things you will be building, you will need servants to manage them all. The more your tower world grows, the more servants you will need.]
"I see. But I have a question. Are these True Names that common?" Kent had to ask. It seemed all he saw now were True Names. Everything about the tower seems to revolve around True Names.
While he had indeed experimented with it when he awakened Uncle Drew to become his first Night Rider, he never truly understood the nature of a True Name.

Vexthra told him that True Names are a person’s free will, but she also said they are much more than that. However, she provided no further explanation. The tower, on the other hand, seemed to know more.
[First, True Names are the rarest things in the universe. In fact, an entire continent may only have one person with a True Name. That is how rare a True Name can be.
However, for some reason, the tower possesses all these True Names that the Master can bestow upon the people he chooses.
I can’t explain why that is because I don’t know. But I do know that True Names embody a person’s free will, as well as their destiny and untapped potential.
Take Uncle Drew, for example. He was just an ordinary carriage driver, but now, he has become one of the legends to ever grace the history books with their might on the battlefield.
Now, he is a Night Rider who commands the night on battlefields. Also, his potential to wield the name Kael Duskbane has been unlocked.

This also means True Names can change a person’s destiny and unlock the potential tied to that True Name. If you bestow and invoke the True Name of a legendary artisan, for instance, that person will begin unlocking the abilities of the legendary artisan.

But True Names are also a person’s free will, so invoking them is akin to enslaving them. However, instead of being negative, since the Master cannot betray the people he links to the tower, this enslavement is nullified.
In a way, the moment you invoke their True Names, they will begin walking the path of the True Name bestowed upon them.]
"I see. Then how are these True Names determine. The True Name Token I used on Uncle Drew has no names on it, yet I manage to bestow on him a true name." Kent asked.
[Even I don’t know. Somehow, I managed to pick the right True Name without knowing how]
"Weird. But can this be trusted? I mean, can this part of you be trusted to pick True Names?" Kent had to ask.
Since true names are meant to change one’s destiny and unlock one’s untapped potential, he had to know if they could be trusted.
[The master shouldn’t worry about that. The tower is meant to protect so it will never harm the master. It’s incapable of harming the master.]
"Okay. I guess I will trust you, Gaia. But now that we have established this, can you tell me how I can obtain more True Name tokens to use on my ladies?"
[The Master can buy them in the Tower shop. Also, you will start receiving them as quest rewards now that the tower has awakened]
"Alright," Kent turns to the last awakened Tower. This particular awakened when he bestowed the night rider’s true name on Uncle Drew.
===Legion Tower===
-- Long ago, during a time of relentless wars, a lone emperor, abandoned by his allies and trusted advisors, faced a grim fate that threatened to shatter the peaceful lives of his people.
-- His army betrayed him, and his generals defected, allying with rival kingdoms and empires. He was left with nothing—no supporters, escape, or hope. Despair consumed him.

-- Then the fateful day arrived, and his empire was swallowed by darkness. Those he once called friends united to destroy everything he had built. In the end, his own sworn brother drove a sword through his heart.

-- In his final moments, the emperor saw a vision—an army numbering in the millions, all bound to him and him alone. This army could not betray him. They would fight for him, unwavering in their loyalty.

-- Yet, this army was no ordinary force. It was not composed solely of humans. Instead, it was a coalition of Spirit Beasts, Vampires, Demons, the Undead, Riders of the Night, Creatures of Myth, and countless others.
-- It was a sight of unparalleled magnificence. With his dying breath, the emperor gave this vision a name—"Legion," for he knew that one day, this legion would rise and grace the battlefields.
[Unique Abilities]
<Legion Eyes>
-- When a being worthy of joining the Legion is seen, the master will know.
<Legion Bind>
-- When the master sees a worthy being, he can add them to the Legion Tower.
<Legion Call>
-- With this connection, the master can call on any and all his legions to match with him on the battlefield.
<Legion Match>
-- When the legion matches on the battlefield, all their stats will be amplified by 400%.
<Legion Bestow>
-- The master can bestow all kinds of skills and techniques on his legion.
<Legion Take>
-- The master can take all kinds of skills and abilities his legions possess.
<Legion Sight>
-- No matter where the master and his legions are, the master can see through their eyes at any time.
<Legion Chat>
-- No matter the distance or planes, the master can communicate with all his legions.
Note: More unique abilities will be known as the master adds more legions to the tower.
[Current Legion]
<Riders of the Night>
<Riders of the Night>
-- The legendary dual-wielding general, Kael Duskbane, and his army of night riders will rise from the tethers of life and death and ride again to the battlefields.
-- Whenever new members join the night riders, they all will receive a 20% boost in all stats.
[Current members]
- Kael Duskbane (Captain)
"That is a lot," Kent said with a smile.
[The Master should take some time later to delve deeply into each tower aspect. I will also ensure the Master learns more as time goes on.]
"Thank you, Gaia." Kent’s smile widened as, for a moment, he imagined himself riding on the back of a bone dragon, leading his legion into battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 128: Bloodline Awakening
paragraphs: "What next, Gaia? I want to review everything before venturing inside. I have loads of things to do, and now that you have awakened, we have to do them with haste." Kent was happy, but he wasn’t about to slack off while he still had a dangerous quest to accept.
He wanted to have all the fun before things went haywire.

[The master has reviewed all the towers, but getting hands-on experience will be great. However, the master must first know that the tower relies on Tower Points, so having loads of them would be beneficial.
Before you ask, tower points are like the soul essence the tower depends on to function. Now, let’s focus on your bloodline.]
Kent nodded and returned his gaze to the messages that had appeared before him.
[Bloodline Awakening Initiated... Your bloodline has begun its awakening.]
[Current Progress: 5%]
[Because your bloodline has started awakening, your physique has also begun to undergo some changes. As your bloodline awakening progress increases, so will your physique.]
"Wait a minute, Gaia. Am I a human or a dragon?" Kent had to ask. Right now, he could feel the changes in his body. He could feel the strength coursing through him.
Also, for some reason, he felt he was no longer human—or at least that was the sensation coming from deep within his bones.
It wasn’t a feeling he could just brush off. Of course, he was waiting to finish reviewing all the messages, but now that this had come up, he had to address it.

[Kekeke. The master is indeed not a human but a one-of-a-kind dragon. Your bloodline is pure and untainted, so the changes starting within you are your bloodline rebuilding your body. It will take some time, but one day, you will become a full-fledged dragon.
For now, only a few changes have occurred, but it is enough to make you understand the power of your bloodline.]
"I see." Kent smiled. He looked at his arm, and with a thought, dark golden scales started appearing on it, signaling that he was indeed a dragon—well, a demi-dragon.
"Say, Gaia, how much of a boost in strength did I receive after the awakening of my bloodline started?"
[Your strength has increased by 120% when in your human form and 220% if you switch to your demi-dragon form.]
"Great. Then I guess I can take on Root Sages now." Kent’s smile bloomed. He couldn’t help but picture the scene he saw when he killed the dark-robed lady in Mokasa Prison.
[The master shouldn’t get ahead of himself. This is a cultivation world; there are many hidden dragons out there. For now, the master should increase his strength by Gaining battle experience.
Thankfully, I can help with that. But it will be best to go against humans.]
"I know, Gaia. I will be going back to the academy soon with my master. There is more fun to be had," Kent replied before turning to the next set of messages.
[You have unlocked the following skills and abilities]
<Dragon Claw>
-- Turn your hands into dragons claws that can be used in combat.
-- All attacks dealt with the dragon claws deal 150% damage.
-- The dragon claws ignore 45% of defenses and deal true damage.
<Dragon Scale>
-- You can now conjure dragon scales on your skin that temporarily boost defense by 200%
-- The dragon’s scales cancel 50% of all physical attacks.
<Dragon Health>
-- Your recovery speed has been boosted by 130%.
<Dragon Presense>
-- When using your dragon form against inferior beings, they will receive a 30% debuff
"Damn, these are some powerful abilities I have here," Kent smiled. There was no doubt the current him felt like a Root Sage had nothing on him.
The buffs he had received were just too much for a Root Sage to contend with. Of course, as the tower said, he shouldn’t look down on anyone.
However, he could tell just by reading this that his strength had transcended to a new height.
’Are all dragons this powerful?’ He couldn’t help but wonder. If 5% was this terrifying, then how much more powerful would he become when it reached 100%?

[All beings that manage to awaken their bloodlines are powerful, even humans. However, there are indeed some beings with bloodlines that transcend the average. These beings are automatically superior.
For example, the lady sleeping beside you has a unique bloodline that will awaken when you add her to your harem and invoke her true name.
In fact, I can’t wait to see what changes will happen to her once she awakens her potential.]
Kent turned and looked at the naked mother-in-law beside him and smiled. The tower, even before her awakening, had already told him she possessed rather potent yin qi for someone at her level.
’Let me finish first,’ Kent turned back to the tower with a smile.

"Gaia, before anything else, I first want to know how I can increase my bloodline. Before this, I was a little scared about the whole ’keys of the apocalypse’ thing, but now, I feel like all hope is not lost. So, I want to know how I can increase the progress."
Since just 5% of his bloodline was this terrifying, he wanted to ensure he could increase it. It would be great if he didn’t die in this medium world.
[There are many ways to increase your bloodline. One of them is through sex. The stronger the lady, the higher your chances of increasing your bloodline.
Another way is to absorb potent treasures that contain high-level spiritual energy. Since I am now in operation, I will be able to use it to enhance your bloodline.
Another method is to kill powerful spirit beasts and absorb their bloodline. This will not only increase your already powerful bloodline but will also advance your progress level.

Additionally, you could go berserk and kill dragons to absorb their bloodlines. This is perhaps a more efficient way since all dragons are arrogant and quick to attack. Finding more to kill won’t be a problem.
However, the fastest way is to become a Pill Sage, which will allow you to concoct bloodline-related pills. Tier 7 pills and above will significantly increase your bloodline.
Lastly, tempering your body will do more good than you think. In fact, with the grade of your bloodline, simply leveling up will have a noticeable effect on it.
You just have to never give up and keep rising.]

"I see. Aside from going on a killing spree among my kind, I’ll stick with the other ways," Kent laughed, knowing what Gaia said was true. Through mass genocide of his kind, his progress would accelerate much faster.
Right now, as a human becoming a dragon, he knew he’d have to do more if he wanted to rise through the ranks. He needed to increase his bloodline, cultivation base, and everything else.
It wouldn’t be easy. However, he wouldn’t have to do too much with the tower by his side.
"Gaia, you said the grade of my bloodline is high. Care to share more?"
[The master possesses a Celestial/Primordial-grade bloodline—the highest level a bloodline can reach in this known universe.]

sentences.text: "What next, Gaia?
I want to review everything before venturing inside.
I have loads of things to do, and now that you have awakened, we have to do them with haste." Kent was happy, but he wasn’t about to slack off while he still had a dangerous quest to accept.
He wanted to have all the fun before things went haywire.
[The master has reviewed all the towers, but getting hands-on experience will be great.
However, the master must first know that the tower relies on Tower Points, so having loads of them would be beneficial.
Before you ask, tower points are like the soul essence the tower depends on to function.
Now, let’s focus on your bloodline.]
Kent nodded and returned his gaze to the messages that had appeared before him.
[Bloodline Awakening Initiated...
Your bloodline has begun its awakening.]
[Current Progress: 5%]
[Because your bloodline has started awakening, your physique has also begun to undergo some changes.
As your bloodline awakening progress increases, so will your physique.]
"Wait a minute, Gaia.
Am I a human or a dragon?" Kent had to ask.
Right now, he could feel the changes in his body.
He could feel the strength coursing through him.
Also, for some reason, he felt he was no longer human—or at least that was the sensation coming from deep within his bones.
It wasn’t a feeling he could just brush off.
Of course, he was waiting to finish reviewing all the messages, but now that this had come up, he had to address it.
[Kekeke.
The master is indeed not a human but a one-of-a-kind dragon.
Your bloodline is pure and untainted, so the changes starting within you are your bloodline rebuilding your body.
It will take some time, but one day, you will become a full-fledged dragon.
For now, only a few changes have occurred, but it is enough to make you understand the power of your bloodline.]
"I see." Kent smiled.
He looked at his arm, and with a thought, dark golden scales started appearing on it, signaling that he was indeed a dragon—well, a demi-dragon.
"Say, Gaia, how much of a boost in strength did I receive after the awakening of my bloodline started?"
[Your strength has increased by 120% when in your human form and 220% if you switch to your demi-dragon form.]
"Great.
Then I guess I can take on Root Sages now." Kent’s smile bloomed.
He couldn’t help but picture the scene he saw when he killed the dark-robed lady in Mokasa Prison.
[The master shouldn’t get ahead of himself.
This is a cultivation world; there are many hidden dragons out there.
For now, the master should increase his strength by Gaining battle experience.
Thankfully, I can help with that.
But it will be best to go against humans.]
"I know, Gaia.
I will be going back to the academy soon with my master.
There is more fun to be had," Kent replied before turning to the next set of messages.
[You have unlocked the following skills and abilities]
<Dragon Claw>
-- Turn your hands into dragons claws that can be used in combat.
-- All attacks dealt with the dragon claws deal 150% damage.
-- The dragon claws ignore 45% of defenses and deal true damage.
<Dragon Scale>
-- You can now conjure dragon scales on your skin that temporarily boost defense by 200%
-- The dragon’s scales cancel 50% of all physical attacks.
<Dragon Health>
-- Your recovery speed has been boosted by 130%.
<Dragon Presense>
-- When using your dragon form against inferior beings, they will receive a 30% debuff
"Damn, these are some powerful abilities I have here," Kent smiled.
There was no doubt the current him felt like a Root Sage had nothing on him.
The buffs he had received were just too much for a Root Sage to contend with.
Of course, as the tower said, he shouldn’t look down on anyone.
However, he could tell just by reading this that his strength had transcended to a new height.
’Are all dragons this powerful?’ He couldn’t help but wonder.
If 5% was this terrifying, then how much more powerful would he become when it reached 100%?
[All beings that manage to awaken their bloodlines are powerful, even humans.
However, there are indeed some beings with bloodlines that transcend the average.
These beings are automatically superior.
For example, the lady sleeping beside you has a unique bloodline that will awaken when you add her to your harem and invoke her true name.
In fact, I can’t wait to see what changes will happen to her once she awakens her potential.]
Kent turned and looked at the naked mother-in-law beside him and smiled.
The tower, even before her awakening, had already told him she possessed rather potent yin qi for someone at her level.
’Let me finish first,’ Kent turned back to the tower with a smile.
"Gaia, before anything else, I first want to know how I can increase my bloodline.
Before this, I was a little scared about the whole ’keys of the apocalypse’ thing, but now, I feel like all hope is not lost.
So, I want to know how I can increase the progress."
Since just 5% of his bloodline was this terrifying, he wanted to ensure he could increase it.
It would be great if he didn’t die in this medium world.
[There are many ways to increase your bloodline.
One of them is through sex.
The stronger the lady, the higher your chances of increasing your bloodline.
Another way is to absorb potent treasures that contain high-level spiritual energy.
Since I am now in operation, I will be able to use it to enhance your bloodline.
Another method is to kill powerful spirit beasts and absorb their bloodline.
This will not only increase your already powerful bloodline but will also advance your progress level.
Additionally, you could go berserk and kill dragons to absorb their bloodlines.
This is perhaps a more efficient way since all dragons are arrogant and quick to attack.
Finding more to kill won’t be a problem.
However, the fastest way is to become a Pill Sage, which will allow you to concoct bloodline-related pills.
Tier 7 pills and above will significantly increase your bloodline.
Lastly, tempering your body will do more good than you think.
In fact, with the grade of your bloodline, simply leveling up will have a noticeable effect on it.
You just have to never give up and keep rising.]

chapters.title: Chapter 129: The Mega Chain Quest
paragraphs: [The master should know that bloodlines vary in grades. They start from Silver, Gold, Platinum, Dark Gold, Monarch, Sovereign, Mythic, Immortal, Ancient, God, Supreme, and Celestial (Primordial).
Nobody knows whether there are stages beyond that, but so far, this is the highest. Your bloodline is at the highest grade—one of the purest.
And before you doubt me, know that the Primordial Chaos Dragon Bloodline has only appeared once. You are truly a special existence.]
"Well, this fills me with joy, I guess." Kent was not sure if he should feel happy or wary. Clearly, one day, people would notice this, and when that happened, he would be in for a wild ride.
[The master should also know that, after conducting a detailed scan of your body, you possess a celestial-grade Spirit Root. You are indeed a special existence.]

Kent smiled, knowing all this was possible because of the inheritance he had received back in the God Realm. For now, he wouldn’t jinx it, but he wanted to understand why and who had created the tower.
Had it not been for the tower he inherited, perhaps he would already be struggling like the average cultivator.
"Gaia, accept the quest first before anything else." Kent wouldn’t want to reject something that could put him out of commission for three years.
[Quest Accepted.]
[Quest Name: Investigate The Hand & Eradicate The Church]
[Quest Type: Mega Chain Quest]
[Quest Difficult: Calamity]
[Quest Description:
--One is a danger to the weak and innocent. The other is a menace to all life.
-- The Dark Devil Church has infested the lands for many years now. Countless Innocents have died in their dark ways. This is why you should end them before things go above board.
-- The Hand is a menace to all life. For now, investigate and know their root. The universe is watching.]
[Rewards: Each chain quest carries its unique rewards. However, once all quests have been fulfilled, you will receive a mega reward from the universe.]
[First Chain Quest: Assassinate Bright Faywood]
-- The Faywood Noble Family is one of the Noble Families in Eldorath Kingdom.
-- They are rich in spirit stone mining and other valuable treasures.
-- Bright Faywood, the head of the Faywood family, has some connections to the Dark Devil Church. Your mission is to assassinate him. Then, absorb his memories to know what he knows.
[Rewards:]
- 100,000 Tower Points
- Memory Key
- True Name Token
[Duration: 7 Months]
[Failure: Failure to complete this quest will result in you losing strength in little Kent for a year. Failure is not an option]
"Gaia, now that you have awakened, what are some of the things you can do regarding information gathering?" Kent asked. He wasn’t about to bet his dick on it.
[Now that I don’t solely depend on your soul strength, I can do more than just know names. I can place trackers on people and use them to monitor and learn more about them.
I can also connect to local records and piece together information by cross-referencing with many other sources.]
"Then how close should I be to someone before you can plant a tracker?"
[Twenty meters, for now.]
"Good. That auction is just a month away. I’ll talk to Manager Alina to put me closer to the VIP booth of the Faywood Noble Family. This will make things easier for us." Kent’s plan was set.

For now, he had to worry not only about his safety but also about that of his women. His mission was to rise through the ranks and ascend to the highest realms, where he had to kill the God of Alchemy.
He wasn’t about to let some underworld organization derail his journey just because they were hungry for power.
"What else should I know, Tower? Now that I have accepted the quest and awakened all the towers, I must at least know the way forward, right?"
He wasn’t about to sit idly when he had such a powerful assistant capable of helping him achieve everything he desired.
That would just be plain stupid. Someone with a tower shouldn’t be an ordinary cultivator. Knowing that, he was meant to shine, and Kent also planned to work hard for it.
[The master must now pay closer attention to the Legion Tower. I don’t want to jinx it, but if the Hand successfully acquires all seven keys, the master will need a strong enough army to fight.
While that would be fun, the master must know that the Race of Apocalypse knows only one thing: eradicating everything in their path.
The master must start preparing. Luckily for you, now that you have access to the quest pool, you can receive quests that will lead you to potential worthy candidates for your legion.
But I advise the master first to become a Sword Master, which involves mastering all 10,002 sword plays. This will push your Sword Intent and Aura to at least the third level of the Enhance stage.
This way, the master can venture into more dangerous places with ease. However, the master should know that raising a legion won’t be easy, so the best approach is to grow stronger much faster.]
"Thank you, Gaia." Kent was already pleased with everything. He knew he now had an edge over the Hand.
Though he wouldn’t jinx it, such situations always came down to a single resolution. Perhaps he could thwart their plans by becoming more active, but he understood that wouldn’t be easy.
The reason was simple. From what he had learned, Lady Olive brought three Sages and over five dozen Root Saints.
That was a formidable force to command. Strangely, none of them had died during the invasion, which suggested they were stronger than the average soldier.
He knew he had to be prepared. To successfully kill a god, he had first to survive the apocalypse.
"Gaia, you can give me your gift now. And please don’t be stingy," Kent laughed. With Cynthia passed out, he wasn’t worried about her overhearing him talking to himself.
[The master shouldn’t worry. I am not stingy. In fact, I will be giving you two rewards. You will need one of the rewards soon if you want to live long enough to tell the tale.

I am sure you will love the other one. But before that, you must know that now, you can talk to Goddess Vexthra for 30 minutes every 100 days. The best part is that you can use the laws of the tower to reset the time.]

"Are you serious? Thirty freaking minutes? With the time difference, I can stay inside the tower for five days, and it will reset. Don’t play with me here, Gaia." Kent glared at the golden tower that only he could see.
[I am being serious. In fact, there is a price that, if you manage to pay, the goddess can teleport into the tower for a limited amount of time.]
"Good. This is really good." His joy was now overflowing. He is, without a doubt, happy about this development.
Kent looked at the sleeping Cynthia. "How long will she be out?"
[Three more hours.]
"Good. Then I have two days to explore the tower." Kent dressed up. "Let’s go."
The next second, he was sucked into the tower, leaving the walking world behind. He appeared in a small blue world with a sun and thirteen moons.
Standing at the center of this blue world was a majestic golden tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 130: The Mischievous Overpowered Tower
paragraphs: "Gaia, why are there 13 moons in the sky?" Kent asked, staring at the strange yet beautiful moons above. Each one looked unique, with different colors and shapes.
One was blue, with a part bitten off like Eve’s apple.
Another was bright red with a gaping hole in its center.
The third was green, its edges jagged like broken glass.
The fourth was dark, its outline sharp as razors.
The fifth was silver, glowing faintly, with cracks across its surface.
The sixth was golden, smooth, and polished like a perfect orb.
The seventh was purple, swirling with misty patterns that seemed alive.
The eighth was orange, shaped like a crescent with uneven points.
The ninth was black, so dense it seemed to absorb all light.
The tenth was white, pure, glowing softly like snow under moonlight.
The eleventh was pink, dotted with shimmering sparkles that danced like stars.
The twelfth was bronze, dull but sturdy, with visible dents and scratches.
The thirteenth was yellow, glowing fiercely, its surface bubbling like molten lava.
[This miniature world is created from the master’s consciousness. This means that, in a way, a trait of your envisioning shaped this world and created it.]
"Hmm, then I guess I have a sense of humor. This place is just weird yet surprisingly perfect. Looking at it makes me feel complete in a way, yet incomplete."
Kent ran his eyes across the 13 moon once more before moving toward the Golden Tower.
Gaia had told him there was only one tower, but it contained many towers. As to what that meant, he was about to find out. After all, he was the master of the tower(s).
"Huh, Tower, how are there modern lights on you? Isn’t this supposed to be a cultivation world where everything is weird?"
Lights surrounded the tower. In fact, at night, it looked like a Christmas tree decoration. These kinds of things couldn’t be found in cultivation worlds.
This meant one thing: the tower had done something weird and would probably continue to do so for who knows how long.
[The design of the tower and everything it holds is from the master’s previous world. I liked it, and since the master is familiar with it, I wanted to bring it to life here.
B-But if you don’t like it, I will change it to look more isekai for you.]
Kent could tell Gaia didn’t really want to change the design she had created. In fact, he wasn’t about to ask her to change it. He kind of liked it.
"Let’s keep it like that, Tower. I don’t mind, and it’ll be good to have my precious world here in my domain. It’ll help me remember my past and where I came from."
Though he couldn’t return to Earth just yet, he knew that in a few years, he would be able to. For now, he had more important things to use the compass for than going back to Earth for revenge.
He had made peace with his death. However, if he ever got his hands on those who killed him, he would love nothing more than to torture them.
Now that he has the tower prison, he can bring them back with him and continue torturing them tell they grow old and die.
When he appeared in front of the Tower, a golden light beam descended on him like a futuristic teleporter. He was sucked into the tower.
Well, a Bifrost bridge would be a more accurate name for what the tower had cooked up—just that his own was golden in color instead of multicolored.

[Welcome to the Tower, Master. As you can see, this place is the admin room. You have access to everything, but to make it much more fun, I created this room, which I will be the only one to use anyway.
But I just wanted to show you. I hope you like it.]

Kent stared at the screens, which showed some of the important towers in the room. On one screen, a pink tower named Harem is plastered on it. Others displayed Sword, Servant, Guardian, Alchemy, Soul, and Legion.
But those weren’t the only screens there. There were others with their names displayed on them:
Tower City, Tower Shop, Tower Storage, Tower Prison.
The place was just too disturbing in a way, but Kent knew the Tower just wanted to have fun. He didn’t care—as long as she played her role well, they wouldn’t have a problem.
"Say, Tower, can you change your form when I’m around?" Kent asked. Having a tower following him was cute but, in a way, disturbing.
[Sure.]
Like she said, she could indeed take other forms, and she did. The Tower glowed, and in the next second, a cute little fairy appeared.
Kent felt uncomfortable in a way, but that feeling was wiped away when a bandana appeared around her head, and then a bandit hat sat on top of that.
Her small wings also turned transparent, and like a pirate, she smiled at Kent, making him wonder whether he should tell her to change again.
But he did not.
Whatever makes her happy. Vexthra did say the Tower is sentient.
"Take me to the Tower Shop," Kent said.
"Aye, Captain!" she replied with a cheeky grin, crossing her tiny arms. "Follow me, and we’ll plunder the finest treasures this shop o’ yours has to offer, arr!"
Kent wanted to give her a slap, but she was just too tiny, with no surface area to slap. But once again, whatever makes her happy.
They vanished, and the next second, they appeared in a room filled with smaller screens, each displaying an image of something.
Kent immediately approached a screen that was showing a skill book. He looked at the screen that displayed its name, grade, rank and description, and Price.
[Name: Infinity Piercing Arrow]
[Grade: Heaven]
[Rank: SSS]
-- Conjure an arrow that travels with speed 50 times faster.
-- Conjuring time reduces as more arrows are being fired.
-- Consumes 100 Spiritual qi per arrow.
[Price: 340,000 Tower Points]
"Not bad, not bad at all. I like this shop room," Kent said, smiling after reading through more than twenty screens. It reminded him of online shopping back on Earth.
"Gaia, can you make a screen similar to this in any room of my choosing? It would be best to have a screen where I and my women can browse through the store."
[That won’t be a problem. But the master must know that some items can’t be accessed just yet since most will be added as you grow stronger.
For now, you have access up to the Divine grade.]
"That’s not an issue. I don’t need skill books for now anyway." Kent loved the shop room. Hundreds of skill books, weapons, clothes, armor, and other treasures could benefit anyone.
"Gaia, you mentioned me needing to buy some talismans to speed up the absorption rate of soul essence from the bead."
[Yes. But since the master will be using the Soul Tower, buying them wouldn’t be of much use.]
"I see. In that case, give me my two rewards before I forget. Also, you should reward my ladies and the ones to come. On Earth, in some countries, there’s something called a grand opening sale.
It’s where your first ten customers, after opening a store, are given items for free."
Kent grinned like a bandit.
